desc: Prove that minimax path values in the original graph equal maximum-edge values along paths in an MST.
Derive and verify the DSU greedy invariant for matching occurrences when components become connected by increasing edge weights.
Implement Kruskal to build/process MST edges sorted by weight, using 64-bit integers for the answer.
Maintain per-component counts of occurrences from arrays A and B, including repeated vertices, and merge them efficiently during DSU unions.
Analyze complexity and edge cases: repeated values, components with only one sequence type, and maximum answer size.
